en: Fe del Mundo designed a bamboo incubator that uses hot water bottles to keep premature babies warm when hospitals lack electricity.
The eight rays of the sun on the Philippine flag represent the first eight provinces that revolted against Spanish colonial rule.
To grow rice on steep mountains, the Ifugao people carved flat, stepped terraces into the slopes to prevent soil erosion and hold water.
A proposed bill becomes an official law only after both houses of Congress approve it and the President signs it.
Jose Rizal wrote Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo to expose Spanish abuses, which awakened Filipino nationalism and inspired the revolution.
The Supreme Court can declare a new law unconstitutional if a citizen challenges it and the justices rule that it violates the Constitution.
Farmers in Lucban decorate their houses with colorful kiping leaves during the Pahiyas Festival to give thanks for a bountiful harvest.
In the traditional Bayanihan practice, an entire community physically carries a nipa hut on their shoulders to relocate a family home.
Before filing a court case, neighbors must first bring their dispute to the barangay Lupon Tagapamayapa for mandatory community mediation.
By registering and casting a ballot during elections, eligible Filipino citizens directly choose their local and national government representatives.
Spain ceded the Philippines to the United States in the 1898 Treaty of Paris, which immediately changed the colonial ruler.
Sculptor Guillermo Tolentino designed the Bonifacio Monument with figures tearing a cedula to visually symbolize the break from Spanish taxation.
